name: LeadSimple
positioning: CRM, shared inbox, phone system and process automation that sit on top of a property management system.
description: LeadSimple is a communication and workflow layer for residential property management companies. It combines an owner and tenant CRM, a shared inbox unifying calls, texts and email on one timeline, a phone system with ring groups and an AI voice agent, recurring process workflows with branching logic and escalation, and maintenance work orders. It does not replace the PMS: it connects to AppFolio, Buildium, Rentvine, Propertyware and Rent Manager. Pricing is published, per seat for the inbox and CRM products and per door for workflows.
real_estate_use: A property management company growing past a few hundred doors finds that the accounting system holds the ledgers but nothing holds the conversation: a tenant voicemail about a water heater, an owner question about a statement, a Zillow enquiry all live in different inboxes and in one person's head. LeadSimple gives every call, text and email an owner and a next step on one timeline, and turns the repeatable sequences — move-in, renewal, inspection, owner onboarding, make-ready — into timed workflows with escalation when a step slips. It is bought by companies that already have a PMS and are losing leads and owner trust in the handoffs around it.
features: Shared inbox unifying calls, texts and email per contact
Phone system with IVR, ring groups, hours-based routing and call recording
AI voice agent answering when nobody picks up
Owner and tenant lead pipelines with speed-to-lead routing and SLA escalation
Recurring process workflows with branching logic and PMS-triggered starts
Maintenance work order intake and tracking

use_cases.job: Stop tenant calls and owner emails from living in one person's inbox
Run move-in, renewal and owner onboarding as timed workflows with escalation
